description: Builds a link-in-bio page on lnx.net from the user's name, links, socials and bio, and returns a claim_url. The user opens it, sees the finished page, can edit it, and publishes it to lnx.net/<username> with an LNX account. Nothing goes public until they do.

bio.description: Short plain-text bio, max 1000 chars. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

links.description: Link buttons, in display order (max 20). Websites, shops, booking pages, newsletters, latest release, etc.

name.description: Display name of the person or brand, shown as the page title.

socials.description: Social profiles shown as icons (max 10). Anything not in the platform list goes in links.

platform.description: twitter means X/Twitter; website is a personal site.

url.description: Profile URL; an email address for the email platform.

tagline.description: One-line subtitle under the name, e.g. "Ceramic artist in Lisbon". Max 120 chars.

theme.description: default = centered, round photo; boxy = full-width cover image; big-image = large photo beside the content.

username.description: Desired address lnx.net/<username>: 3-30 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -. Omit to derive one from name.

name: create_page
title: Create a link-in-bio page
